title: SEC6: Config-time Ed25519 key validation prevents runtime signing failures
description: dkim config validation (config.rs lines 559-595) decodes and validates seed/pubkey format and length at startup, before any signing. This prevents malformed key material from reaching drain loops where signing failures would defer or dead-letter traffic. Correct because DKIM keys are immutable once config is loaded; validation upfront is cheaper than per-sign checking.
